name: v2.18.0
body:
## What's Changed
* fix / race condition in api throttler acquire() by @mnaamani in https://github.com/hummingbot/hummingbot/pull/8461
* fix: release previous reference in PyRef assignment operator by @Janche in https://github.com/hummingbot/hummingbot/pull/8444
* fix /Update Lighter SDK to 1.1.2 by @andrewgbell in https://github.com/hummingbot/hummingbot/pull/8435
* fix/ preserve LP volume across POSITION_HOLD closure by @mlguys in https://github.com/hummingbot/hummingbot/pull/8496
* fix / allow dydx v4 perpetual non-trading connector initialization without mnemonic (Fixes #7409) by @naufalfx805-source in https://github.com/hummingbot/hummingbot/pull/8477
* feat / upgrade Derive spot & perpetual connectors to the v3 API by @isreallee82 in https://github.com/hummingbot/hummingbot/pull/8491
* fix / price backtest stop-loss exits at the stop, not the bar close by @zorionarrillaga in https://github.com/hummingbot/hummingbot/pull/8507
* CI conda PATH fix by @cardosofede in https://github.com/hummingbot/hummingbot/pull/8536
* feat / bitget unified connector by @isreallee82 in https://github.com/hummingbot/hummingbot/pull/8343
* sync / development to staging v2.18 by @rapcmia in https://github.com/hummingbot/hummingbot/pull/8539
* okx-perp-ws-ping-8296 by @cardosofede in https://github.com/hummingbot/hummingbot/pull/8550
* remote-api-pickle-rce-8085 by @cardosofede in https://github.com/hummingbot/hummingbot/pull/8561
* kraken-fill-timestamp-8199 by @cardosofede in https://github.com/hummingbot/hummingbot/pull/8559
* dydx-oneway-log-flood-8482 by @cardosofede in https://github.com/hummingbot/hummingbot/pull/8560
* dca-sim-index-8523 by @cardosofede in https://github.com/hummingbot/hummingbot/pull/8558
* foxbit-eval-rce-8083 by @cardosofede in https://github.com/hummingbot/hummingbot/pull/8562
* sync / development to staging v2.18.0 - update 20261113 by @rapcmia in https://github.com/hummingbot/hummingbot/pull/8563
* Sync / Staging to master v2.18.0 by @rapcmia in https://github.com/hummingbot/hummingbot/pull/8574

## New Contributors
* @mnaamani made their first contribution in https://github.com/hummingbot/hummingbot/pull/8461
* @Janche made their first contribution in https://github.com/hummingbot/hummingbot/pull/8444
* @andrewgbell made their first contribution in https://github.com/hummingbot/hummingbot/pull/8435
* @naufalfx805-source made their first contribution in https://github.com/hummingbot/hummingbot/pull/8477
* @zorionarrillaga made their first contribution in https://github.com/hummingbot/hummingbot/pull/8507

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/hummingbot/hummingbot/compare/v2.17.0...v2.18.0
